'''Lightball''' was a type of sport. During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], footage of the [[galactic lightball playoffs]] was broadcast in the [[Cantina Oceana]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Dorumaa]].
